# Feature Request / 功能建议

## 需求或建议 / Request or Suggestion
你希望增加、修改或改进什么？  
What would you like to add, change, or improve?

## 使用场景 / Use Case
你为什么需要这个功能？你希望用它完成什么？  
Why do you need this feature, and what would you like to achieve with it?

## 当前遇到的问题 / Current Problem
现在的软件在哪一步让你觉得不方便、难理解，或无法完成目标？  
What is currently inconvenient, difficult to understand, or preventing you from achieving your goal?

## 期望的效果 / Expected Behavior
你希望这个功能大致如何工作？  
How would you ideally like this feature to work?

## 补充说明 / Additional Notes
如果有示例、截图、世界观设定或参考产品，可以一起说明。  
If relevant, feel free to include examples, screenshots, worldbuilding context, or reference products.
